ios.desc:
Haplo is your AI investing analyst. It monitors your watchlist, scores every stock 0-100, identifies real setups, and alerts you before the move - all explained in plain English.

SMARTER SIGNALS
- A 0-100 setup score for every stock on your watchlist, updated daily
- Five sub-scores behind every number: trend, momentum, MACD, strength, and stretch
- Watchlist Radar shows at a glance which names lean bullish or bearish

AI WITH A REAL TRACK RECORD
- On-device AI models score every stock's odds of a big move
- A transparent backtest shows exactly how the signals would have performed - every trade listed, nothing hidden
- Simulated results, honestly labeled - never cherry-picked

KNOW BEFORE THE MOVE
- New-setup alerts the moment the AI spots something on your watchlist
- Price and earnings alerts, all local and private
- A morning brief timed to the market open

NEWS IN PLAIN ENGLISH
- Every headline comes with "what this means" for your stocks
- Daily lessons and concept drills to sharpen your edge

EVERYTHING ON A STOCK IN ONE PLACE
- Live charts from 1 day to 5 years
- Technical patterns spotted for you
- Financials, stats, and AI analysis side by side

Haplo is built for active traders - swing traders, day traders, and anyone who wants a second opinion that never sleeps.

All signals, scores, and backtests are educational tools, not investment advice. Simulated performance does not guarantee future results.

Haplo Premium is available as an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
